Title: Verify GET /posts returns 200 with a non-empty JSON array of posts
Precondition: The API endpoint https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts is reachable from the test environment.
Steps: 1. Send an HTTP GET request to https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts → Expected: The API returns a response | 2. Assert: response status is 200 → Expected: Assertion holds | 3. Assert: header "content-type" contains "application/json" → Expected: Assertion holds | 4. Assert: JSON body is a non-empty array → Expected: Assertion holds | 5. Assert: response time is under 5000 ms → Expected: Assertion holds
Expected Result: response status is 200; header "content-type" contains "application/json"; JSON body is a non-empty array; response time is under 5000 ms
